Brissago Islands.fact: While not interested in botany and gardening, Emden preserved the existing garden and vegetation, undertaking the necessary maintenance. Emden continued the baroness's exotic partying, entertaining young ladies who would water-ski and dance naked in the garden.

Brissago Islands.fact: Emden lived on the islands until his death in a clinic in Locarno in 1940.
